seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Cañon City, CO: the Royal Gorge Route Santa Express, tree lighting, Parade of Lights, Santa at the library and a model train open house.
lede: Cañon City does Christmas with a Santa train through the Royal Gorge, a tree lighting at Gateway Depot and Plaza, a Parade of Lights on Main Street and Santa at the library.
celebrates: Cañon City's season starts with the Royal Gorge Route Railroad's Santa Express, which runs from the depot at 401 Water Street. The City of Cañon City hosts a Christmas tree lighting, with the Cañon City Madrigal Singers, hot chocolate and cookies, and this year the ceremony moved to Gateway Depot and Plaza from Macon Plaza. The Royal Gorge Chamber Alliance and the Downtown Cañon City Main Street Program present the Christmas Parade of Lights on Historic Main Street, and Cañon City Public Library hosts a visit with Santa and Mrs. Claus.
lastyear: Christmas 2025 in Cañon City included a Santa visit at Cañon City Public Library on Saturday, December 13, from 10 am to 2 pm, which the City of Cañon City's official calendar listed as free. The Royal Gorge Route Railroad's Santa Express, which the railroad says began in 2005, is a longtime part of the city's holiday season.
facts: The Royal Gorge Route Railroad has run its Santa Express since 2005, and the railroad says Santa and his elves board the train at the North Pole in the gorge. The 2026 Christmas Parade of Lights is the 37th annual one, according to the Main Street Program's listing. This year's tree lighting moved from Macon Plaza to Gateway Depot and Plaza, at 9th Street and Royal Gorge Boulevard, according to the city.
trains: Cañon City is the home of the Royal Gorge Route Railroad, which departs from its depot at 401 Water Street and runs through the Royal Gorge along the Arkansas River. Its Santa Express runs from November 19 to December 30, 2026. In Florence, the Florence Pioneer Museum holds a Model Train Open House on December 19. For a rail outing in Pueblo, the Pueblo Railway Museum runs Christmas trains on December 11, 12, 18, 19 and 24, and our Pueblo page lists them.

faq: Where do Cañon City kids see Santa?

Santa boards the Royal Gorge Route Railroad's Santa Express at the North Pole in the gorge, and Santa and Mrs. Claus take pictures at Cañon City Public Library on December 12, 2026. Santa's sleigh is also on display at the tree lighting on December 2. Each listing on this page has current details.
When is the Cañon City Christmas parade?
The 37th Annual Christmas Parade of Lights is on Saturday, December 5, 2026, on Historic Main Street, with vendors from 5 pm and the parade at 6 pm. The listing on this page has the host's details.
Is there a Christmas train near Cañon City?

Yes. The Royal Gorge Route Railroad runs its Santa Express from November 19 to December 30, 2026. The Florence Pioneer Museum also holds a Model Train Open House on December 19, and the Pueblo Railway Museum runs trains in December.
Where is the Cañon City tree lighting?
The City of Cañon City lights the tree at Gateway Depot and Plaza, at 9th Street and Royal Gorge Boulevard, on December 2, 2026. The city says it moved there from Macon Plaza.
